Assessment
1. Clinical Data & History Review:
Mr. Terrell Gusikowski (DOB 1980-11-16, MRN SYN-0575722) is a 43-year-old male presenting with 4 months of progressive right upper quadrant fullness, early satiety, and smooth non-tender hepatomegaly.
- Epidemiologic & Exposure History: Born and raised in the Naryn region of Kyrgyzstan on a family sheep farm with herding dogs; assisted with home slaughter of sheep as a teenager before moving to the US in 2016. This is a classic high-risk exposure for Echinococcus granulosus.
